name: functions-gamebot
description: Standalone Cloud Functions codebase for the mysheba GameBot. Deployed separately from the main app's functions/ codebase. Writes only to roomChats/*/messages, gameBotSessions/*, gamePoints/*, gamePointsLedger/*; read-only on roomChats/{roomId} itself (to see which game is active) — never wallets, transactions, salary data, or the room doc.
